2. **`merge_intervals`** (lines 21, 24): Changed `intervals.sort()` to `sorted(intervals)` so the argument is never modified (as docstring requires); changed `<` to `<=` on line 24 so intervals that *touch* are also merged.

3. **`find_free_slots`** (lines 46-54): Added clipping of busy intervals to `[day_start, day_end]`, added the check for trailing gaps after all busy intervals end, and changed `>` to `>=` on line 50 so a gap of *exactly* `min_len` is included (per "a gap of exactly min_len minutes is long enough").
